questions.q: ___ it was raining, we went out.
questions.why: Дощ і прогулянка суперечать одне одному — це протиставлення, тому *Although* + речення. *Despite* вимагає іменника або *-ing*.

questions.q: ___ the rain, we went out.
questions.why: Перед іменником (*the rain*) — *Despite*. *Although* вимагає речення з дієсловом.

questions.q: I went to the shop ___ buy milk.
questions.why: Мета — *to* + дієслово: *I went to the shop to buy milk.* *for buy* — калька з «для».

questions.q: I spoke slowly so ___ he could understand.
questions.why: *so that* + речення (часто з *can / could*): *so that he could understand*.

questions.q: We stayed home ___ the weather.
questions.why: Перед іменником — *because of*: *because of the weather*.

questions.q: It was late, ___ we left.
questions.why: *so* — наслідок: було пізно, тому ми пішли.

questions.q: He was ill. ___, he went to work.
questions.why: *However* — протиставлення в новому реченні: хворів, проте пішов на роботу.

questions.q: Tom is tall, ___ his brother is short.
questions.why: *whereas* — протиставлення двох фактів: *Tom is tall, whereas his brother is short.*

questions.q: Despite ___ tired, she finished.
questions.why: Після *despite* — *-ing*: *Despite being tired*.

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: Although it rained, but we went.
Although of the rain, we went.
questions.why: *although* і *but* разом не вживаємо. *Despite* не стоїть перед реченням.

questions.q: ___ being tired, she finished the report.
questions.why: Після *Despite / In spite of* — *-ing* або іменник: *Despite being tired*.

questions.q: He saved money ___ that he could buy a car.
questions.why: *so that* + речення: *so that he could buy a car*.

questions.q: I left early in order ___ to miss the bus.
questions.why: Заперечна мета — *in order not to* + дієслово (*not* перед *to*).

questions.q: The match was cancelled ___ to the storm.
questions.why: *due to / owing to* + іменник: *due to the storm*.

questions.q: ___ it was late, we took a taxi. (відома причина)
questions.why: Відома причина на початку — *As / Since* (або *Because*).

questions.q: She is rich. ___, she isn't happy.
questions.why: *Nevertheless* — «проте» в новому реченні.

questions.q: I'm learning English ___ get a better job.
questions.why: Мета — *to* + дієслово: *to get a better job*. *for get* — калька з «для».

questions.q: This knife is ___ cutting bread.
questions.why: Призначення речі — *for* + *-ing*: *a knife for cutting bread*.

questions.q: The roads were icy. ___, there were many accidents.
questions.why: *As a result* — наслідок: дороги були слизькі, тому багато аварій.

questions.q: ___ the fact that he was ill, he went to work.
questions.why: *Despite the fact that* + речення. *Although the fact* — помилка.

answer: Although it was raining we went for a walk
Although it was raining, we went for a walk
We went for a walk although it was raining
questions.why: *although* + речення; частини можна міняти місцями.
questions.hint: Хоч і йшов дощ, ми пішли гуляти.

answer: I spoke slowly so that she could understand
So that she could understand I spoke slowly
questions.why: *so that* + *could* — мета: щоб вона зрозуміла.
questions.hint: Я говорив повільно, щоб вона зрозуміла.

answer: We stayed inside because of the heat
Because of the heat we stayed inside
questions.why: Перед іменником (*the heat*) — *because of*.

questions.q: Take an umbrella ___ it rains.
questions.why: *in case* — «на випадок, якщо»: *Take an umbrella in case it rains.* Після *in case* — теперішній час.

questions.q: ___ being tired, she finished the report.
questions.why: Перед *-ing* — *Despite*. *Although* і *Even though* вимагають підмета й дієслова.

questions.q: I'll go to the party ___ you don't come.
questions.why: Ще невідомо, чи ти прийдеш, — умова: *even if*. *even though* — про відомий факт.

questions.q: He works ___ a waiter at weekends.
questions.why: У ролі, на посаді — *as*: *He works as a waiter.* *like* — «схоже на».

questions.q: She left early so as ___ to miss the train.
questions.why: *so as not to* + дієслово — заперечна мета.
